commands: '=== PoC: can a scheduled task launch a GUI process into the DISCONNECTED interactive session? ==='
'Subject is notepad.exe, NOT the engine - this must not disturb the running memory test.'
if($eng){'engine PID {0} in session {1}  (must be UNCHANGED at the end)' -f $eng.Id,$eng.SessionId}else{'engine NOT RUNNING'}
'--- did notepad appear, and in WHICH session? ---'
if($np){ $np | ForEach-Object { 'notepad PID {0} SESSION {1}' -f $_.Id,$_.SessionId } } else { 'notepad DID NOT START' }
'this SSM script is running in session {0}' -f $sysSess

if($np){ if(($np | Where-Object {$_.SessionId -ne 0})){'PASS - launched into a NON-ZERO (interactive) session. A GUI app CAN be started this way.'}else{'FAIL - landed in session 0. No interactive desktop; a WinForms app would be invisible.'} } else {'FAIL - process did not start at all.'}
if($eng2){'engine PID {0} session {1} - still running, untouched' -f $eng2.Id,$eng2.SessionId}else{'WARNING: engine not running'}
